## Objective

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and reason for the change.

## Baseline and scope

- Repository / branch / base SHA:
- Affected modules or docs:
- Non-goals and existing changes preserved:

## Authority and evidence

Link relevant product decisions, accepted ADRs, feature contracts and source.
Distinguish approved policy, actual behavior and any conflict found.

## Constraints and acceptance

State the key invariants, authorized environment/actions and observable success,
failure, permission and retry criteria.

## Result

Describe the final change and meaningful deviations from the approved scope.

## Verification

| Command or scenario | Actual outcome | SHA / environment / CI evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

List skipped/blocked checks and why. Distinguish source inspection, historical
evidence, local emulation, staging and live verification.

## Risks and recovery

Record remaining uncertainty, compatibility/rollout limits, rollback or
compensation. Link release gates when relevant.

## Approvals and next action

- Already authorized actions:
- Open decision IDs / specific approvals still needed:
- Next owner and action:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused diff; only authorized files/actions changed.
- [ ] Relevant source, permissions, atomicity, retries and privacy reviewed.
- [ ] Appropriate checks reported honestly; skipped checks explained.
- [ ] Canonical docs/status/ADRs updated where applicable; links checked.
- [ ] No new product rule, provider, retention or release approval inferred.
